summary: Norrath exists within a complex planar cosmology shaped by divine realms, elemental planes, and Discord’s corruptive influence.

planes.name: Plane of Fear
planes.notes: A realm of terror feeding on mortal dread.

planes.name: Plane of Hate
planes.notes: A realm forged from pure hatred.

planes.name: Plane of Growth
planes.notes: A realm of nature’s divine essence.

planes.name: Plane of Sky
planes.notes: A realm of dragons and celestial trials.

planes.name: Plane of Earth
planes.notes: A realm of stone, caverns, and subterranean life.

planes.name: Plane of Water
planes.notes: A realm of oceans, tides, and aquatic beings.

planes.name: Plane of Fire
planes.notes: A realm of flame, destruction, and volcanic power.

planes.name: Plane of Air
planes.notes: A realm of storms, winds, and ethereal beings.

planes.name: Plane of Time
planes.notes: The nexus of temporal flow and divine conflict.

planes.name: Realm of Discord
planes.notes: A realm of chaos, war, and planar corruption.

cosmic-structure.material-plane: Norrath exists as the central material world.
cosmic-structure.planar-barriers: Planar boundaries weaken during eras of turmoil, allowing incursions.
